soundcircle.config.title: SoundCircle
soundcircle.config.option.enabled.desc: Show nearby sounds as a circle around your crosshair.
soundcircle.config.option.radius.desc: Size of the circle around the crosshair.
soundcircle.config.option.icon_scale.des: Scale of the sound icons placed around the circle.
soundcircle.config.option.opacity.desc: Overall visibility of the indicators. Lower it to make them less distracting.
soundcircle.config.option.ring_opacity.d: How visible the guide ring is.
soundcircle.config.option.show_icons.des: Show an icon next to each direction marker.
soundcircle.config.option.mob_heads.desc: Show the face of the mob or player that made the sound instead of a generic icon.
soundcircle.config.option.show_player_na: Show the name of the player who made a sound below their face.
soundcircle.config.option.show_ring.desc: Draw a thin ring around the crosshair while sounds are shown.
soundcircle.config.option.show_labels.de: Show the subtitle text of each sound below its icon.
Show how many blocks away each sound is.
Show an arrow when a sound comes from above or below you.
soundcircle.config.option.pulse_danger.d: Make dangerous sounds like a hissing creeper or lit TNT pulse.
soundcircle.config.option.max_distance.d: Sounds farther away than this are ignored.
soundcircle.config.option.duration.desc: How long a sound stays on the circle after it was heard.
soundcircle.config.option.max_indicators: Maximum number of sounds shown at once.
soundcircle.config.option.show_own_sound: Also show sounds made by yourself, like your footsteps or blocks you break.
soundcircle.config.option.ignore_ambient: Skip background noise like rain, cave sounds, flowing water, lava, fire and dripping.
soundcircle.kind.danger.desc: Hissing creepers, lit TNT, explosions, ghast and warden attacks.
soundcircle.kind.hostile.desc: Zombies, skeletons, spiders and other monsters.
soundcircle.kind.combat.desc: Attacks, hits, arrows, shields and other fighting.
soundcircle.kind.footsteps.desc: Steps of players walking near you.
soundcircle.kind.blocks.desc: Doors, chests, pistons, blocks being placed or broken.
soundcircle.kind.environment.desc: Water, lava, fire, weather and cave ambience.
